trigger_ar: زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
after: their deeds as instruments the adversary turns into a means of diversion
reason: The sequence زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ makes the beautified deeds function as a tool that turns them away. The use branch of ع م ل can therefore be heard beside the ordinary sense of deeds.

after: their works also as the use of materials in building, whose trace remains in their dwellings
reason: The dictionary's use branch includes a builder putting bricks to work. The nearby مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ supplies the independent construction cue, so أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ can carry an image of building labor whose surviving houses testify to the past.

after: their deeds faintly as entrusted service under a guardian
reason: أَوْلِيَآءَ names guardians whom people take besides God, calling the dictionary branch of entrusted authority. The verse describes false reliance rather than an appointed office, so the connection to assigned work remains only a note.

after: deeds with a faint wage-bearing or paid-effort image
reason: Ibrahim is given أَجْرَهُۥ in the world, a direct reward word that calls the wage branch of ع م ل. The focus still says deeds, not wages, so the payment image is secondary.

after: deeds placed in a reciprocal recompense relation
reason: The promise وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ joins acts to a return for them, which faintly calls the transaction branch. Divine recompense is not the dictionary's ordinary dealing between people, so this remains a note.

after: deeds faintly as an account to be settled
reason: In Fatiha, recited in every salah, يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ can carry the financial debt sense alongside judgment. Beside أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ this invites an account-and-settlement image, though the dictionary's transaction branch is specifically interpersonal.

after: their deeds faintly as handiwork produced by human workers
reason: تَصْنَعُونَ in 29:45 names what people make or do and can call manual craft. The focus word remains general deeds, while the laborer branch is specifically a group of handworkers.

after: deeds faintly as work requiring an aptitude for making
reason: The making verb تَصْنَعُونَ supplies a real work cue for the branch of being naturally suited to labor. It does not say that the makers have the branch's specific durability or inborn aptitude, so the link is only partial.

after: their deeds also echoing functioning faculties, especially clear-seeing eyes
reason: B010 gives a formed use of ع م ل for an operative body part, including an eye that sees at a distance. The closing مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ explicitly calls sight in this ayah, so the working-eye image can be heard beside أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ and its plain sense.

after: deeds weakly colored by the arm as a bodily measure
reason: ذَرْعًا in the Lot episode means capacity or breadth, and its root can evoke the arm-span behind measurement. That gives the body-part branch a weak cue, but the verse does not name an arm or an operative limb.

after: their deeds also as a well-traveled road from which they are turned aside
reason: The dictionary preserves ع م ل for a path made clear by repeated walking. In this ayah فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ supplies the road trigger, allowing أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ to be heard as the route of conduct as well as deeds.

trigger_ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ
after: deeds faintly with the image of an old, worn route
reason: The named ʿĀd and Thamud are presented through their surviving مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ, which makes an ancient route image plausible beside the old-road branch. Neither the names nor the dwellings literally say road, so this is only a note.

after: their deeds faintly as a course people follow
reason: The spider-house مَثَلُ is offered as a model about taking guardians, and a well-trodden road can be an image of a course followed. Since this parable is not literal travel, the route reading stays tentative.

after: deeds faintly as a moral track that could lead toward worship
reason: The concept route in this line reaches the command ٱعْبُدُوا۟ and other way-of-life words in the surah. That makes the beaten-road branch a possible image for a practice or course of conduct, but the target remains the plain word for deeds.

after: deeds faintly as a road made smooth by worshipful service
reason: The paired Fatiha branch for ع ب د includes smoothing or paving a road, and نَعْبُدُ is the actual recited word. It offers a weak bridge from service to the well-traveled-road sense of ع م ل, rather than evidence that the deeds themselves are literal paving.

after: deeds as a faintly normed route, set against the straight path sought in Fatiha
reason: Fatiha asks for ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ, a daily recited path image that sharpens the focus ayah's diversion from ٱلسَّبِيلِ. This is a useful route contrast, though it partly overlaps the direct path reading in line 2.

after: their works faintly as foot travelers obstructed from a road
reason: The branch names people who travel on foot, and عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ directly supplies a route with people turned away from it. Since أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ is grammatically deeds rather than travelers, the human journey image remains a note.

after: deeds faintly as the walkers' moral journey toward worship
reason: The concept path through س ب ل B002, people who use a road, reaches ٱعْبُدُوا۟ in the surah. It lends a pedestrian image to the course of conduct, though the word for works does not itself name travelers.

trigger_ar: أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
after: deeds faintly among the walking and wandering images of Fatiha's path
reason: Fatiha places أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ beside the path of the favored and the contrast with ٱلضَّآلِّينَ, which can open a traveler's journey image. The verse says favor and misguidance, not literal walking, so this stays a note.
